summary: Add a nullable boolean column marketing_opt_in with DEFAULT false, backfill existing rows to false, deploy the new version using a state‑only migration, retire the old version, and finally set the column NOT NULL so that all rows have a non‑null value.
write_consistency: Both versions write false to marketing_opt_in: the old version gets the column's DEFAULT false on INSERT, the new version sets it explicitly; therefore no NULL values appear while both are live.

stages.description: Add marketing_opt_in column with DEFAULT false
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN marketing_opt_in BOOLEAN DEFAULT false;

stages.description: Set marketing_opt_in to false for any remaining NULL rows
sql: UPDATE account_user SET marketing_opt_in = false WHERE marketing_opt_in IS NULL;

stages.description: Retire the old version so it no longer serves traffic

sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN marketing_opt_in SET NOT NULL;
